app.title: пташечка — cross stitch & bead pattern designer
app.description: Design cross stitch and bead patterns: key, chart, totals, pattern and OXS files.
app.dragToMove: Drag to move · double-click to put back
app.resizePanel: Drag to resize · double-click for the default width

tools.eraser: Eraser (E) — erases crosses, beads, partial stitches, knots and backstitch. Point at a backstitch line to delete only that line
tools.picker: Pick a key entry from the chart (I, or hold Alt/⌥)
tools.select: Select (S) — drag a box; Shift adds
tools.magicWand: Magic wand (W) — same key, connected; Shift+click selects all of that key
tools.partial: Partial stitches (Q cycles quarter / three-quarter / petite)
tools.override: Override (O): when on, drawing replaces stitches already on the chart. Off = only empty squares are filled.

status.underlayHint: Editing the image behind the chart · drag to move · corners resize (Shift = free) · arrows nudge · Esc or U = done

key.heading: Key
key.emptyHint: Add the threads, blends, beads, knots and backstitch you’ll use — with their strands, stitch type and symbol — then pick an entry and draw.
key.rowTitle: Click to draw with this · double-click to edit
key.highlight: Highlight the selected entry — everything else fades (V)

totals.heading: Totals & shopping list
totals.toBuy: To buy · {threads, plural, one {# thread} other {# threads}}, ≈{skeins} skeins

classic.note: Half crosses count as half the thread of a full cross (quarters ¼, three-quarters ¾, petites ½); blend parts count toward each thread.

label.knotWraps: French knot, {wraps, plural, one {# wrap} other {# wraps}}

keyDialog.lineStyleHint: click to choose the line used in the Symbols view
keyDialog.chooseFlossBead: Choose a floss and a bead.
keyDialog.chooseBlend: Choose two different threads for the blend.
keyDialog.duplicate: Same colour, strands and stitch as {entry} already in your key. You can still add it with its own symbol.
keyDialog.typeLocked: This entry is already on the chart — only cross stitch ↔ floss + bead can be swapped
keyDialog.layerLocked: Can’t move an entry that’s on the chart to a different layer
keyDialog.findBlend: Find a blend for a colour:

dialogs.deleteEntryBody: It’s used {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} on the chart. Deleting the entry removes those stitches too.
dialogs.resizeHint: Shrinking crops anything outside the new edges.
dialogs.name: Name
dialogs.keepKey: Start with the same key (threads, beads, symbols)
dialogs.newHint: Unsaved changes to the current pattern will be lost — save first if you want to keep it. A snapshot is kept in History.
dialogs.noPatterns: No saved patterns yet. Patterns are saved here automatically while you work.
dialogs.imageTitle: Turn a picture into a pattern
dialogs.imageHint: Each colour becomes a key entry: full cross, {n, plural, one {# strand} other {# strands}}. You can edit entries afterwards and the chart follows.
dialogs.keepReference: Keep the photo open as a reference window (with the stitch grid)
dialogs.gotoHint: Column, row — in the chart’s numbering (e.g. 12, 40)
dialogs.badCell: That cell isn’t on the chart
dialogs.mirrorTargetFull: The other half already has stitches. They will be replaced.
dialogs.copyFallback: Downloads aren’t available here. Copy this text into a file ending in .{ext}.
dialogs.clearMarksBody: This removes everything you’ve marked on “{name}”.
dialogs.closeRefBody: Its marks will be deleted too.
dialogs.drop: Drop a .xbird or .oxs pattern, or a picture
dialogs.versionsHint: Saved automatically before big changes and every few minutes while you work.
dialogs.deleteSavedBody: Delete {name} from this browser? This can’t be undone. Downloaded .xbird files are not affected.

references.pan: Move / zoom the photo (or right-drag; wheel zooms)
references.marker: Marker — paint over what you’ve done
references.grid: Overlay the pattern’s stitch grid on the photo (and follow your cursor on the chart)
references.done: Shade squares you’ve already stitched on the chart

toasts.needKeyEmpty: Add something to your key first — click “+ Add to key”
toasts.needKey: Pick an entry in the key first
toasts.fillBackstitch: Fill doesn’t apply to backstitch or knots — use draw or line
toasts.overrideOn: Override on — drawing replaces existing stitches
toasts.overrideOff: Override off — only empty squares are filled
toasts.saveFailed: Could not save here — use Save to file instead
toasts.tooLarge: Pattern is too large to save in the library — use Save to file
toasts.loadedReport: Loaded {name} — {count} quarter stitches or ornaments simplified or skipped
toasts.badFile: Couldn’t read that file — it should be a .xbird pattern or an .oxs
toasts.dropHint: Drop a .xbird or .oxs pattern, or a picture
toasts.refsTooBig: Reference photos are too big to remember in this browser — use Menu ▸ Download pattern file (.xbird) to keep them
toasts.newTwins: {count, plural, one {# new key entry} other {# new key entries}} for mirrored half crosses
toasts.pasted: Pasted — click or press Enter to place
toasts.partialNeedsCross: Partial stitches use a cross-stitch entry — pick one in the key
toasts.straightened: Photo straightened to the chart grid

underlay.heading: Image behind the chart
underlay.behindHint: The image sits under your stitches; all tools work. Turn off (or press U) to move, resize or crop it.
underlay.editHint: Edit mode: drag to move, corners resize (Shift = free), Crop trims edges. Tick “Behind stitches” or press Esc when done.
underlay.adjustWithMouseTitle: Edit with the mouse: drag, resize corners, crop (U)
underlay.padHint: Resizing keeps the middle of the screen in place — zoom into the area you are aligning and click.
underlay.straightenTitle: Drag the photo’s corners onto the chart grid; the picture is flattened to fit it exactly
underlay.padToggle: Quick move & resize panel on the chart
underlay.padToggleHint: A small floating panel to nudge and stretch the image at any zoom
underlay.closePad: Hide this panel (turn it on again in the side panel)

fileMenu.label: Menu ▾
fileMenu.newFromImageHint: Convert a photo or drawing into stitches
fileMenu.versionsHint: Automatic backups of this pattern — restore an earlier state
fileMenu.downloadHint: Everything — key, chart, reference photos, image behind the chart. Open it again with “Open file from computer”
fileMenu.pngSymbols: Chart image — symbols only, for printing (PNG)
fileMenu.oxsHint: Opens in Хрестики and Ruta Stitch
fileMenu.refWindowHint: A movable window next to the chart, with progress marks
fileMenu.refUnderlayHint: Lies under your stitches, aligned to the grid, to trace over
fileMenu.guideHint: Step by step: an e-copy of a paper chart

current.title: Drawing with
current.noEntryHint: Pick one in the key below

straighten.title: Straighten the chart photo
straighten.hint: Drag the 4 corners onto corners of the chart’s grid on the photo — the outer border works best. The blue lines show where the grid will fall; arrow keys nudge the last corner by 1 px (Shift: 10).
straighten.crossed: Corners are crossed — put them in order: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left

points.1: The quickest way from a paper chart to a digital one.
points.2: 8 short steps — a couple of minutes.
points.3: Come back any time: <hl>Menu ▸ Quick start guide</hl>.

points.2: Enter the size in stitches — as on the paper chart.

key.title: 2. The key

points.1: Every line of the paper key: <hl>+ Add to key</hl>.

key.tip: Keep the key in view: <hl>Photo in a floating window</hl>. Tick off added lines with its <hl>marker</hl>.

trace.title: 3. Chart behind the stitches

points.1: Add the chart photo: <hl>Image behind the chart</hl>.
points.2: Drag the <hl>4 corners</hl> onto the grid corners — the photo lies flat.
points.3: Trace the symbols with the key entries.

trace.tip: Photo not perfect? Turn on <hl>Quick move & resize panel on the chart</hl> (side panel, <hl>Image behind the chart</hl>) and adjust it block by block, 10×10.

points.2: Hold <hl>Alt/⌥</hl> — pick a colour from the chart.

points.1: Your work saves itself in the browser.
points.2: But browsers can wipe it — regularly use <hl>Download pattern file (.xbird)</hl>.

points.1: Made a mess? <hl>Versions</hl> bring back an earlier state.

points.2: Export an <hl>Open Cross Stitch file (.oxs)</hl> — for Хрестики and Ruta Stitch.
The guide is always here: <hl>Menu ▸ Quick start guide</hl>.
